item:
select p.*, stat.*, pp.id_day, pp.price, pp.points last_points, pp.locked, pp.diff, pp.owned,
                                                        if(hm.aktivny is null,0,1) as active, stat.pptime, stat.icetime, (pp.price - pp0.price + pp0.diff) as sdiff,round(average/(pp.price/1000000),1) as permil,if(stat.domaci=hm.id_muzstvo_sezona,1,0) as ha,hc.status as status,substring(p.name,1,1) as fletter,
                                                        hn.poznamka as note
							from fnt_fan_player p
							left join sbjni_ft_hrac_attrs hattr on hattr.id_hrac = p.id
							left join sbjni_ft_hrac_hotcold hc on hc.id_hrac=p.id
							left join sbjni_ft_hrac_muzstvo hm on (hm.id_hrac=p.id and hm.aktivny=1)
							left join fnt_fan_player_price pp on (p.id=pp.id_player and pp.id_day=0)
							left join fnt_fan_player_price pp0 on (p.id=pp0.id_player and pp0.id_day=826)
				            left join sbjni_ft_user_hracnote hn on p.id = hn.id_hrac and hn.id_user='0'

							left join (select dc.id_hrac ids,	
								sum( dc.dokopy ) AS points, count( dc.id_hrac ) matches, avg( dc.dokopy ) average, 
								sum(z.goly) goals, sum(z.asisty) assists,sum(z.goly+z.asisty) as pts, sum(z.plsmns) plusminus, sum(z.tresty) pm, sum(z.shots) shots, 
								sum(z.hits) hits, sum(z.blocks) blocks, sum(z.gwg) gwg, sum(z.otg) otg, sum(z.ppg) ppg, sum(z.shg) shg,
								sum(z.gwin) gwin, sum(z.otl) otl, sum(z.loss) loss, sum(z.ga) ga, sum(z.save) saves,round(100*(1-(sum(z.ga)/sum(z.save+z.ga))),1) spct, sum(z.so) so,replace(sec_to_time(round(sum(time_to_sec(z.pptime))/count(*))),'00:0','0') as pptime,replace(sec_to_time(round(sum(time_to_sec(z.totaltime))/count(*))),'00:','') as icetime,r.id_domaci as domaci,date_format(r.datum,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as datum,sum(z.sog) sog
								from sbjni_ft_dobber_cache dc 
								JOIN sbjni_ft_rozpis r ON (dc.id_rozpis = r.id)
								join sbjni_ft_zapas2 z ON ( z.id_hrac = dc.id_hrac AND z.id_rozpis = dc.id_rozpis )
                                                                
								 WHERE  (r.datum between "2024-10-04" and "2025-06-30")  AND z.totaltime!='00:00:00'								
								GROUP BY dc.id_hrac 
								) stat on p.id=stat.ids
							 WHERE  pp.price > 0  AND  p.position != ''  AND  pp.price >= 0  AND  pp.price <= 15000000 
							 order by surname desc,active desc
							 limit 0, 60000
